# Landing Renderer Dependencies

These files preserve the versions in the original landing import map:

- Three.js 0.183.2: build modules and OrbitControls/RoomEnvironment addons.
- stats-gl 4.0.2: main module (renamed stats-gl.js) and its sibling modules.
- lil-gui 0.21.0: ESM distribution.

Source: the corresponding npm packages. Upstream license notices are preserved;
Three.js's MIT license is also included as THREE-LICENSE. The matching source
and served copies live under raayo-landing and public/raayo-landing respectively.
